svg.title: The ELI5 output style and the card-guard Stop hook
svg.desc: You send a prompt to Claude. The output style ELI5 shapes every reply into one blockquote card. When CARD_GUARD is set, the card-guard Stop hook checks that the final reply is one card. In log mode a fault goes to the card-guard.jsonl ledger and the reply is shown. In block mode a reply that is not a card at all is sent back to be written again, once. CARD_GUARD is unset by default, and then the hook does nothing.
svg.text: the reply is shown to you
CARD_GUARD unset (default): the hook exits before it reads anything. log: ledger only, never refuses.
block: refuses a reply with a line outside the quote, or HTML. strict: refuses every fault.
